operations.title: Semidirect Mackey compatibility is governed by geometric-sum linear norms, not parity
operations.statement: For K semidirect <A> with elementary-abelian K, the n-th power map on quotient fiber h has linear part S_{h,n}=sum_{i=0}^{n-1} A^{ih}; Mackey compatibility on that fiber holds exactly when S_{h,n} is invertible.
operations.scope: Finite split extensions and algebraic coefficient-function/group-basis correspondences; no physical chain transfer.

operations.title: Odd-index hostile A4 to C3 twisted-norm test
operations.protocol: Enumerate every fiber for indices 1 through 9 in A4=(C2)^2 semidirect C3 and direct-product control, comparing fiber bijectivity with linear-norm rank.
operations.falsifier: A4->C3 passes on a nonidentity fiber at n=3, the direct product fails, or enumeration disagrees with norm rank.

operations.title: Semidirect linear-norm Adams gate research packet

operations.outcome: pass: A4->C3 has rank-zero norm and fails at n=3; direct-product control has rank two and passes; 2592 exact checks over 54 fiber/index cases

evidence.paraphrase: Exact exhaustive result agrees with the geometric-sum rank criterion.
